statement: There is a universal Ccap with the following property. Fix L1 ≥ 2, 0 < hl < hh < ∞, and 0 < ξ < hl/16. For all sufficiently small s > 0, depending on these parameters and D0, and each j < J, there is an event in Fj whose complement has probability at most Cr25 j , on which, simultaneously for rj ≤ |y| ≤ 4L1rj and hl ≤ h ≤ hh, Hj(y) ≤ Ccap|y|−4 , |y|6 µj(y) > kh3/2 =⇒ |y|4 Hj(y) ≥ h − ξ, |y|6 µj(y) < kh3/2 =⇒ |y|4 Hj(y) ≤ h + ξ. (2.5) The probability constant may depend on the fixed comparison parameters, but Ccap does not. The estimates are uniform in Z, the ground state, j, and J.
